## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      7 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 02.09.2026 - 04.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Will_, 04.09.2026, 1/5: "Premium is $80 /yr and then they want an additional $99 /yr for meal plans. Crazy expensive."
            2. _Sean Kramer_, 03.09.2026, 1/5: "This app used to be great and stable but a few years ago Private Equity got their greedy hands on it. Now there are bugs galore for normal app functions while simultaneously raising the price for subscriptions to $20/mo. look elsewhere, this is a sinking ship."
            3. _A Yates_, 02.09.2026, 2/5: "Barcode scanning used to be included and now its locked behind a paywall. Also, there is no reason to include AI in this app. It's a waste of resources."
<!--/ir-theme-->
